verdict.rationale: An enterprise AI support platform could reasonably offer full API parity with its UI, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no public API at all, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The available claims cover no-code UI workflows (AOPs, Duet) and outbound JWT access to customer systems, which are adjacent features rather than an API that mirrors UI capabilities.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
